selection_rules.gun: Strict waterfall: referenced weapon attackMaxDist, then the same mount AttackShellMaxRadius, then the same mount AttackMaxRadius; aimMaxDist is last-resort only. Physical shell maxDistance is audit-only.
selection_rules.reference_mode: StaticModelReference for operational/model fields; StaticAimLimitReference only for the documented weapon aimMaxDist last resort.
selection_rules.missile: Normalize bullet.rocket, then use a strict waterfall: rocket rangeMax, guidance controlRangeMax, unit AttackMaxRadius, launcher attackMaxDist (fallback). maxDistance and guaranteedRange are audit-only. Max only selects among alternative weapons/missiles of the same envelope kind.
selection_rules.envelopes: At most one gun and one missile envelope per unit; candidate evidence retained in unit.weapons. Gun: largest actual caliber, then largest sourced radius at equal caliber. Missile: largest sourced radius among actual missiles.
selection_rules.weapon_roles: Exclude actual dummy/smoke/decoy and unguided rockets. On units with guided anti-air missiles exclude self-defence guns below 20 mm from envelopes only. Retain dedicated light AA guns/HMGs on units without SAMs.
selection_rules.radar_support: No weapon threat circle; retained for inventory completeness.
